title: Export to .agents/skills
description: Export skills to the shared .agents/skills folder used by Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, and other agents that support the open Agent Skills location.

title: Export to .claude/skills
description: Export skills to Claude Code's project skill discovery folder.

title: Export to pipeline destination
description: Export skill folders directly into the selected pipeline destination, without adding a .agents/skills or .claude/skills prefix.

title: Preserve folder hierarchy
description: Keep Supernova skill folders as category folders in the exported output. When disabled, skills are flattened and duplicate names receive numeric suffixes.

title: Add Supernova metadata
description: Add Supernova update timestamp and provenance information to the SKILL.md frontmatter metadata field.

title: Generate debug files
description: Export _debug files with raw SDK responses and generated output metadata for troubleshooting.
